text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Try to limit sugary drinks and fast food. Second, exercise regularly. Even a short walk every day can make a big difference. Third, get enough sleep, because your body needs rest to stay strong. Mental health is just as important as physical health, so take time to relax and talk about your feelings. Finally, keep a good work-life balance. Don't work too much, and enjoy time with family and friends. Small daily habits lead to a healthier, happier life.
